paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The graph illustrates the accuracy trends over epochs for both training and validation datasets, with accuracy measured as a percentage on the vertical axis and epochs on the horizontal axis. The training accuracy, represented by a blue line, begins at approximately 45% and generally increases, showing fluctuations, to reach nearly 100% by the final epoch. The validation accuracy, depicted by a green line, starts at around 45% and also rises, though more gradually and with less volatility, stabilizing near 82% by the end of the 30 epochs. Both lines exhibit an overall upward trend, with the training accuracy consistently higher than the validation accuracy throughout the training process.
